leads.candidate: Eisenholzbaeume am Untermainkai (Parrotia persica, Persian ironwood, multi-stemmed group)
leads.reason: On the official 2025 Naturdenkmal register (entry 026) and on public riverside promenade ground (Untermainkai, Innenstadt), so likely publishable. Blocked only on evidence: the frankfurt.de detail page 403s to curl and WebFetch (Cloudflare) and no wayback snapshot could be fetched this pass (archive.org rate-limited us with 429 after repeated calls). Height/crown figures reported by WebSearch's own summary (19-23m height, 19-22m crown) were never confirmed on a directly-fetched page per the no-search-summary-as-source rule, so they are NOT recorded as fact. Next pass: retry the wayback snapshot once the 429 cooldown has passed, or find a second source (monumentaltrees.com browser session, a Frankfurt tree blog, Wikimedia Commons file description).

leads.candidate: Schwarze Maulbeere an der Liebfrauenschule (Black mulberry, Morus nigra)
leads.reason: Facts look strong (WebSearch summary: ND entry 017, ~200+ years old, girth 3.31m, height 12m, planted ~1760, stands beside the grave of Goethe's mother Catharina Elisabeth Goethe who was buried there in 1808) but every source found describes it as standing 'auf dem Schulhof' (on the schoolyard) of the Liebfrauenschule. Hard rule 10's school test requires real evidence the grounds are genuinely open (a public path, a churchyard the school merely borders, stated weekend access) before a school-ground tree ships, and no source fetched this pass stated that. The Goethe grave connection suggests it may actually be in or beside the adjoining Liebfrauenkirche churchyard rather than a closed schoolyard proper, which would pass, but this needs a source that says so explicitly, not an inference. Do not ship without that evidence. All numeric claims here also came only from a WebSearch summary, never a directly-fetched page, so they need re-confirming too.

leads.candidate: Sumpfzypressen im Zoo Frankfurt (5 Bald Cypresses, Taxodium distichum, at the Grosser Weiher pond)
leads.reason: On the official register (entry 018), inside Frankfurt Zoo (paid entry, so access is fine per the paid-entry rule). Only the official register plus a WebSearch summary (not a fetched page) describe it so far; no independent second source or measurements confirmed yet. Likely verifiable next pass via photo-auge.de (found in search results: https://photo-auge.de/bedeutende-baeume/sumpfzypresse-im-frankfurter-zoo/, not yet fetched) or the Zoo's own site.
